Expired codes fail automatically, so on any other response offer the user a fresh code rather than retrying the old one."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I deliver the passcode by voice call instead of SMS?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. POST to /sendotpbycall with FROM, TO and the boolean Template field, and Signalmash reads the code out over a phone call. It suits landlines, slow carriers and users who ask to be called, and works best as a fallback offered after the first SMS attempt."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do I have to generate or store the OTP myself?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. Signalmash Verifier generates an encrypted passcode tied to the user session, delivers it and expires it after the window configured on your account, typically 30 seconds to a few minutes.
